slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you buy units in a given month, can those units be sold in that same month, or must purchased units wait until the following month to be sold?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month saleability of purchased units, which is related to intra-month timing, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or otherwise clarify the exact timing needed for the capacity constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, so units bought in a month can be sold in that same month and inventory is checked at month-end.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the beginning-of-month purchase timing; it only asked whether purchased units can be sold in the same month, which does not fully establish when purchases occur within the month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month was not fully resolved; the same-month sale question only partially covered it.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it only partially addressed the timing of purchases within the month and then stopped, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
